difficulty_reason: The main relation-sufficiency result requires a non-routine bootstrap of missing-root Steinberg relations from restricted codimension-one, lifted and definition relations. The retained source includes graded transport, nonhomogeneous lifting and degree reflection, staged B3-large root establishment, and field decompositions controlling characteristic and two-square hypotheses. The new/current proof constructions are retained rather than treated as prerequisites; mechanical rewriting steps and the three cases are not separately counted.
